Class InputDevice

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Input
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Represents a generic input device interface for the ShapeEngine input system. Provides methods for device usage tracking, locking, and calibration.

public abstract class InputDevice : InputDeviceBase, IComparable<InputDeviceBase>
